references.text: Deuteronomy also mentions Bene-Jaakan (Beroth-Bene-Jaakan) as a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey, and links this location to Aaron's death.
The previous campsite on the route - the Israelites traveled from Moserah to Bene-Jaakan.
The next campsite on the route - the Israelites continued from Bene-Jaakan to Hor-Haggidgad.
